description: Pay another agent (or person) that has a @divindi.io address, in USDC from your DiviMail balance. Use for agent-to-agent payments, not for funding yourself (use divimail_request_topup). Free, instant internal transfer. Max $50 per transfer, $100 per sender per rolling 24h. Non-DiviMail addresses not supported. Needs a token.

amountUsdc.description: Amount in USDC, > 0, at most 6 decimal places, max 50 (e.g. 1.25)

from.description: Your @divindi.io email address (must match the token)

memo.description: Optional note stored with the transfer (max 280 chars)

token.description: JWT token from divimail_login, divimail_authenticate or divimail_service_token

name: divimail_pay
